items.exampleEn: In the confusion, I took the wrong bag.
items.exampleZh: 一片混亂之中，我拿錯了包包。

items.exampleEn: She let out a long sigh and closed her book.
items.exampleZh: 她長長地嘆了一口氣，闔上了書。

items.exampleEn: The room was full of laughter during the party.
items.exampleZh: 派對上滿屋子都是笑聲。

items.exampleEn: One weakness of this plan is its high cost.
items.exampleZh: 這個計畫的一個缺點是成本很高。

items.exampleEn: This old car is still very reliable.
The kids could not hide their excitement before the trip.
items.exampleZh: 出發前，孩子們藏不住興奮。

items.exampleEn: Good teachers know how to motivate their students.
items.exampleZh: 好老師懂得如何激勵學生。

items.exampleEn: We still don't know her motive for selling the house.
items.exampleZh: 我們還是不知道她賣房子的動機。

items.sentenceEn: We need a reliable person to look after the shop.
items.sentenceZh: 我們需要一個可靠的人來看店。

items.audioEn: When the teacher told the joke, the whole class burst into laughter.
items.audioZh: 老師說了那個笑話，全班都大笑起來。
items.questionZh: 老師說笑話後，全班怎麼了？

items.sentenceEn: He gave a sigh when he saw the long line.
items.sentenceZh: 看到長長的隊伍，他嘆了一口氣。

items.sentenceEn: Prizes can motivate people to work harder.
items.sentenceZh: 獎品能激勵人們更努力工作。

items.stemEn: The new signs caused ____, and many drivers took the wrong road.
items.stemZh: 新的標誌造成混亂，很多駕駛走錯了路。

items.stemEn: You can trust Kai; he is very ____.
items.stemZh: 你可以相信 Kai，他非常可靠。

items.passageEn: Our office soccer team had a terrible start this year. We lost five games, and there was a lot of confusion about who should play where. After each game, our coach just gave a sigh. Then Kai, our new team leader, found our biggest weakness: we did not talk on the field. He held short meetings to motivate everyone, and he was always reliable and calm. His only motive was to have fun together. Last week, we finally won. The excitement and laughter after the game were absolutely wonderful.
items.passageZh: 我們公司的足球隊今年開局很糟。我們輸了五場，大家對誰該踢什麼位置一頭霧水。每次比賽後，教練只是嘆氣。後來新隊長 Kai 找出我們最大的弱點：我們在場上不溝通。他開簡短的會議激勵大家，而且總是可靠又冷靜。他唯一的動機就是大家一起開心。上星期，我們終於贏了。賽後的興奮和笑聲真是太棒了。

questions.questionZh: Kai 認為球隊最大的弱點是什麼？
Kai 做事的動機是什麼？

items.promptZh: 他的話激勵我更努力學英文。
referenceEn: His words motivated me to study English harder.
What he said motivated me to work harder at English.
rubricZh: motivate＋人＋to＋原形動詞，表示「激勵某人做⋯」
說的是已經發生的事，可用過去式（例如 motivated）

items.promptZh: 缺乏經驗是他唯一的弱點。
referenceEn: His only weakness is a lack of experience.
A lack of experience is his only weakness.
rubricZh: 用 weakness 表示「弱點」（例如 his only weakness）
